You are working too hard for your own good.

You have a gift to share. Whether you are a coach for mindset, health, business, relationships, or sports, you are here to help people. But right now, your business is a job that never ends.

You are tired. You are running in circles. You have no time to breathe. You need a way to serve your people without losing yourself in the process.

Stop the Burnout, Talk to Me

I help you build a business that serves you.

I create the path that moves people from interested to student while you sleep. I build the systems that bring in steady revenue without your constant input. I take the weight of the doing off your shoulders so you can get back to the impacting.

More time for you.

More money for your future.

More impact for your students.

Start Your Transformation Here

Okunade Abdulakeem

Systems Builder · Coach Partner

Top Rated

A partner, not a worker.

My name is Okunade Abdulakeem Olalekan. I do not just build things; I listen to what you want to achieve and find the shortest path to get there. Your online presence is the foundation of your success.

How you are perceived by others decides who trusts you. I make sure that foundation is strong, honest, and truly reflects the weight of your work. My goal is for you to feel supported, not stressed.

“Great experience working with Abdulakeem! The site came out clean, professional, and exactly on brand. Fast turnaround, good communication throughout, and delivered what was promised without back and forth. I have used him in the past and consider him to be part of my design team. Thanks again, Abdulakeem!”

Frank Lind@upwork

“Abdulakeem did an excellent job once again, showing both strong performance and a consistently positive attitude. His willingness to stay engaged, support others, and approach tasks with enthusiasm made a real difference. He brings a great energy to the team, and it does not go unnoticed. We truly appreciate his efforts and the commitment he continues to show in his role.”

Carlos Liena@upwork

“Working with Abdulakeem was an absolute pleasure. He updated my website beautifully, every detail was handled with care, precision, and genuine dedication. He not only fulfilled every part of our agreement but went above and beyond my expectations. His communication was clear, his follow-through exceptional, and the finished result truly exceeded what I had hoped for. I am so grateful for his commitment and creativity, and I would happily work with him again in the future.”

Natalie Scobercea@upwork

“Abdulakeem was very prompt in responses to questions that I had. He worked tirelessly to see my project come about in a prosperous and efficient manner. He understands systems and processes within the industry and framework I was working within. Overall Abdulakeem was an absolute gentleman in the entire process.”

Luisa Panettier@upwork

“It was a fairly straightforward job rebuilding a website from Wix onto GoHighLevel, and so we set the rate as a project. But when there was a slight problem at the end of the transfer, Abdulakeem went above and beyond to not only engage GHL customer support to try to fix the problem, but when it proved not to be fixable, he rebuilt the website over again without any pause or consideration. I think most would agree with me that technical skills are important, but integrity and conscientiousness are even more so. I would highly recommend Abdulakeem for anyone looking for a reliable person their needs.”

Dr David Hall@upwork

“Okunade created and delivered a professional, user-friendly, and inviting website for my clients. Throughout our collaboration, he was consistently responsive to my feedback and questions. He was open about challenges he faced and worked quickly to get answers to resolve issues. His prompt updates on the project's progress emphasized his commitment and dedication to delivering quality work. Despite my delays in securing his services, Okunade's professionalism and courtesy never wavered. He consistently sent me monthly good wishes, which demonstrated his genuine commitment to helping me and readiness to engage when I was prepared. I enjoyed working with Okunade and look forward to using him in the future.”

Selene Antonini@linkedin
